column7: The password-reset and SSO/SAML-begin per-IP budgets failed OPEN on LoginAttempt storage errors (IsPasswordResetRateLimited/IsSSOBeginRateLimited false, Record* dropped the write). Andrei 2026-10-10 18:52 (AUTH-AUDIT-1 item 5): no auth budget fails open. Every budget now goes through the shared limiter (internal/core/auth_budget.go) with a bounded in-memory fallback at the same limit and window, audited auth.rate_limit_error and counted keyorix_auth_rate_limit_fallback_total{budget}. Red on the parent: password-reset, sso and saml begin answered 200/400/400 instead of 429 with storage down; green: byte-identical 429 on all 11 budgeted /auth routes. Class guard: TestEveryAuthRoute_IsClassifiedAndBudgeted (router.go-derived) and internal/core TestAuthBudgetStorage_OnlyThroughTheSharedLimiter (both mutation-checked).
